active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: First frozen tri-scope baseline established in 688a: 674a/675a IV-only, 688a anchor-only, and 676a joint38 share the zero-center normalized-innovation AR flow recipe with rollout energy 0.2, channel-level energy 0.05, train samples 2, rollout steps 4, all train windows, no contrast, no AR1 prior. It is a real framework-lock baseline but not final deployable: IV-only is 7/11, anchor-only panel is realistic, joint38 IV-facing is 5/11 while joint factor panel remains acceptable.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: Factorization, not another score weight. Direct normalized-innovation flow variants trade off marginal calibration, level occupancy, dependency/path structure, regime coverage, kurtosis, and h7 mean reversion without breaking the joint 5/11 ceiling.
last_result_summary: 696a compared 676a, 689a, 691a, 692b, 694a, and 695a. 676a remains the best balanced joint baseline by coverage/calibration and level law. CRPS improves conditional MAE and coverage floor but not gates. Variogram improves dependency/pathwise and h7 ratio but worsens coverage/level occupancy. Source scale collapses. No objective/readout variant exceeds 5/11.
next_step_recommendation: Stop adding scalar score terms to the same direct flow. Next HEAD step should be paradigm ideation for a conditional marginal-plus-dependence law: calibrated per-channel/per-horizon conditional marginals in normalized-innovation space, then a shared copula/dependency generator over PIT or score-residual variables. Keep it generic across iv_only, anchor_only, and joint.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general state-aware normalized-innovation family, 674a/675a remains the strongest IV-only candidate at 7/11. The frozen tri-scope baseline is 674a/675a IV-only + 688a anchor-only + 676a joint38: anchor-only is realistic, joint panel is acceptable, but joint IV-facing is only 5/11. 689a group-head keeps joint at 5/11 and is a readout falsifier, not a new best. 682a remains the best native joint38 score at 6/11, but uses contrast and is not part of the frozen non-contrast framework-lock baseline.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
